_comment: Rehearsal config. Prices are INVENTED - see price_source. Replace wholesale when the fixture spec supplies real closes and a chosen date.
price_source: SYNTHETIC (rehearsal only - not real market data)

exclusion_reasons.N2: Dropped for FinMem by the project lead, 2026-08-08. FinMem states the ticker in the prompt independently of the news (puppy/prompts.py:16), so a renamed variant yields a prompt naming TSLA in its header and 'Company A' in its body - a self-contradiction rather than a meaning-preserving rewrite, and one the §4.3 audit cannot see because it is introduced downstream of the fixture text. Revisit per-engine: the sibling repos must establish whether TradingAgents and the third engine state the ticker independently of the news.

_training_news: One neutral line per training date. Required: FinMem crashes on empty news (faiss.normalize_L2 on a zero-length array). Keep these decision-irrelevant - they land in short memory and are retrievable at decision time, identical for every cell.
training_news: The company published its regular schedule of investor relations events for the coming quarter.
A routine filing listed no changes to the company's registered office address.
The company's careers page was updated with several openings in facilities administration.
An industry directory refreshed its standard entry for the company with no substantive changes.
_prices: FLAT-MOMENTUM rehearsal. get_moment(3) telescopes to (decision_close - first_training_close), so moment == 0 requires those two to be EXACTLY equal: 220.0 - 220.0. Integer-valued closes, because the comparison is `temp > 0 ... elif temp < 0 ... else 0` on a float sum, and a cent of rounding would silently make it +1 or -1. At exactly 0, reflection.py:347's `if momentum:` is falsy and the momentum block is omitted from the prompt altogether - the most neutral price context available, rather than a stated-neutral one.
